svg.title: The Sundering Isles
svg.desc: a chart of the broken coast, the scatter & the drowned road — generated by tools/draw-map.mjs from data/maps/sundering-isles.json. A terrain wash per hex, the ground texture that terrain prints in, a shoreline with wave lines beside it, the watercourses run downhill from the high ground, the settlements and the lanes between them, in a timber frame with a lettered index. The hex grid is a hairline here and an overlay at read time from the same rows, so the two cannot disagree.
